# numspot_kubernetes_cluster (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "numspot_kubernetes_cluster" "kubernetes-cluster" {
  cidr       = "10.20.0.0/16"
  name       = "test-tf-kube"
  profile    = "small"
  version    = "1.33"
  visibility = "EXTERNAL"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) Type defining a CIDR (Classless Inter-Domain Routing) according to the CIDR syntax defined in RFC 4632
- `name` (String) A string that inherits rules from StrictSlug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores, and must start and end with a letter or digit.
- `profile` (String) Profile of the cluster.
- `version` (String) Kubernetes version of the cluster.
- `visibility` (String) Cluster exposition method.

### Optional

- `air_gap` (Boolean) If true, workloads won't have internet access.
- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the Cluster
- `dedicated_etcd` (Boolean) Enable dedicated etcd cluster for this Kubernetes cluster. When true, a separate etcd cluster is deployed in the tenant namespace for data isolation.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_on` (String) Cluster creation date.
- `full_version` (String) Cluster Kubernetes patch version.
- `id` (String) A string representing uuid.
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Timeout for cluster creation. Defaults to 15m.


<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String)
- `reason` (String) Cloud-neutral classification of a failure. Present only when there is a diagnosable reason; the raw provider message is never surfaced.
- `state` (String)
